summary: Frontend-only testing of the redesigned Tienda de Skins showroom (master-detail 'Sala de exhibición'). Authenticated via POST /api/auth/demo, set localStorage primal_token, then navigated to /tienda-skins. All required data-testids present and behavior matches spec: hero-skin-banner renders the large display case with rarity chip, display-skin-name (initial 'Obsidian' — highest-rarity destacado pre-selected), attribute chips, price and buy-btn-{id} 'Comprar con Stripe'. skins-list contains 15 skin-card-{id} rows grouped under rarity headers (Mítico, Legendario, Épico, Raro, Poco común — Común header hidden because no common items in seed, which is correct). catalog-count reads '15 skins en la vitrina'. Master-detail interaction verified: clicking skin-card-{id} for 'Trike Dorado' updated display-skin-name in place (no modal) and the row got highlighted with bg-amber-400/10 (gold). Search 'x' -> 3 results, dino filter 'Austroraptor' -> 2 results, sort 'Precio: menor' applied. No horizontal overflow at 1920x800 (desktop) nor 390x844 (mobile); mobile stacks vitrina on top (banner_top=190) with list below (list_top=1209). Screenshots saved.
critical_code_review_comments: TiendaSkins.jsx is ~380 lines and clean; DisplayCase and SkinRow are well-separated. Consider extracting DisplayCase and SkinRow into /components/shop/ for reuse if the file grows further.
In load() the catch swallows the error silently; for observability consider logging or a toast when catalog fetch fails.
test_credentials: POST /api/auth/demo -> JWT stored as localStorage.primal_token (demo user, role=admin)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview headless loses Steam session on reload; always set demo token before navigating to /tienda-skins. The 'Común' rarity group header is conditionally hidden when no common items exist in filtered set (this is by design via groups useMemo filter g.skins.length). Stripe checkout was NOT executed per instructions.
